verdict.rationale: No first-party evidence documents a free tier or per-unit rates. Community comments confirm published plans exist, but describe them as plan-based with 'arbitrary limits' and ask for a PAYG option, which suggests per-unit pricing is not offered. Neither a free tier nor per-unit rates that would let a buyer project memory costs is evidenced.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see published pricing with a free tier and per-unit rates so I can project memory costs before committing
